convention: 16 headings dK (K=0..15), 22.5 deg apart. d00 = SE (screen down-right, +i/+j grid travel as the existing _SE). K increases counter-clockwise on screen and seen from above: d00=SE, d02=E (screen right), d04=NE, d06=N (screen up), d08=NW, d10=W (screen left), d12=SW, d14=S (screen down). Equal to the existing files: d00=_SE, d04=_NE, d08=_NW, d12=_SW. headingDeg = K*22.5 measured on the ground plane (not on screen). In Blender the model's +X front is rotated by 90 + 22.5K deg about Z. Ground-plane travel vector for heading h: g=(cos h, sin h) in (SE, NE) grid units; travelAxisPx = g_SE*[64,32] + g_NE*[64,-32] (2x px per +1 tile). To choose a sprite from a velocity screen vector v: K = round(atan2-based heading/22.5) mod 16, i.e. pick the K whose travelAxisPx is closest in angle to v. Note that equal ground steps are NOT equal screen-angle steps, because the iso view squashes them.

fields.anchor: body centre (ground point under the middle of the body), shared by all 16 dirs of a vehicle; anchorPx is the same in integer px
fields.bodyFront: tiles (20 m) along travel from the anchor to the front bumper (+)
fields.bodyRear: tiles along travel to the rear bumper (-)
fields.travelAxisPx: 2x screen px for +1 tile of travel in this heading
fields.headlightOffsetPx: bodyFront*travelAxisPx: put the anchor of headlightGlow here (2x px from the vehicle anchor)
fields.taillightOffsetPx: bodyRear*travelAxisPx: put the anchor of taillightGlow here
fields.glows: fx_*_dKK, blend add, drawOrder underVehicle (draw before the vehicle sprites)
